name: Rob & Roll
detailed_description:
Take command of a horde of dice-goblins stealing relics for a mysterious wizard in this turn-based strategy roguelike! Fight your way across the lands using your dice to unleash powerful abilities and overrun your enemies; turbo-charge your dice with gizmos to give them extra effects; and pull off earth-shattering combos to lead your clan to victory!

Craft Your Strategy, Push Your Luck

Equip an arsenal of dice and tactics to define how you’ll approach each battle and outmanoeuvre your foes. Use your dice individually to harass your enemies, or use them together to fuel powerful tactics each turn. Don’t forget to throw in some extra dice to OVERCLOCK your tactics and unleash their full potential. Don’t have the symbols you need though? Just use one of your rerolls. What are the odds you roll all blanks again?

Discover Dice-Breaking Combos

Every face of your dice can be outfitted with any number of game-changing modifiers, drastically altering their effects. A dice could reroll itself when used, create even more dice when rolled, or even activate one of your tactics multiple times!

Upgrade Your Arsenal

Shape the way your dice evolve with the power of gizmos and chisels. You can swap gizmos between dice at any time between battles, but the changes made by chisels are powerful and permanent, so choose wisely!

Command A Menagerie Of Goblins

From the lowly Gobbie to the beautiful, burly Beeflin, a wide array of goblins await your call to come flying into the fray! Each type of goblin has their own unique abilities that can be overcharged even further with clever use of your dice. Will you create a gargantuan goliath? Or load your Gobopult with a horde of little guys? The choice is yours!

Choose Your Clan

Each run you’ll pick from a host of specialised clans, each with their own distinctive abilities that help define your strategy. Want a reliable, defensive playstyle? Pitch in for the Bone Clan. Hardcore aggression more your style? Take the Blood Clan for a spin!

Pick Your Loot

Before you set out across the kingdom you need to swipe something for that wizard! Luckily you’re fully equipped to steal a legendary relic from one of the game’s dungeons, you just need to pick which one. The deeper you delve, the more valuable the relic and the harder your foes will be hunting you down.

But be careful, the relics are also brimming with strange and ancient magicks, so they’ll apply all manner of dangerous effects to your run. If you’re in a pinch you could try to use one of its unique active abilities… Just hope it doesn’t go horribly wrong.

What’s coming:

  • New Unique Mechanics

  • More Dice

  • More Tactics

  • More Gizmos

  • More Goblins

  • More Clans

  • More Relics

  • More Goofs

  • More Enemies & Bosses

  • Steam Workshop & Mod Support
